arguments.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production RGBA battle animation source, NOT a promotional illustration. Input 1 is the canonical face, fitted armor, adult body proportions and material rendering. Input 2 is the accepted standing-body scale and costume reference only. Create FOUR genuinely different consecutive full-body drawings in a strict equal 2x2 grid, 1536x1536 square, transparent background. Natural 8-head adult proportions, small mature narrow grey-green eyes, stern long almond eye shape, defined straight nose and jaw, cool intimidating expression matching Input 1 exactly. No cute face, no round childlike eyes, no enlarged head, no smile. Face, hands, armor and cape share the same refined 2D animation/painterly rendering. Preserve silver flowing hair, every white-silver armor plate and gold thorn trim, black joint undersuit, slim long legs, long ivory cape with black lining and gold embroidery. Hair is flowing fine natural strands not plastic spikes. Each figure occupies ONLY 62% OF ITS QUADRANT HEIGHT with broad fully empty margins. The subject must not fill the cell. Keep head-to-sole height equal across figures before accounting for crouch. Fit the entire cape and each complete fingertip and toe well inside each cell. Keep trailing cape gathered in compact folds behind body rather than spreading 2 body-heights sideways. Four distinct isolated characters surrounded by abundant empty space. The native-sized asset packer will restore exact 610-pixel anatomy; this source-sheet margin is only technical packaging. Each holds ONLY the exact short black/gold grip stub in his right armored hand: NO GUARD, NO BLADE, NO EXTRA WEAPONS. The approved blade/guard will be rigid-composited later. Five anatomically correct fingers gripping naturally, connected wrists, no extra fingers. Same camera: full-body 3/4 facing RIGHT, eye-level battle sprite, minimal perspective, no zoom or foreshortening changes. Redraw the ENTIRE connected head/neck/body for every pose, do not paste faces. No ground disc, labels, text, particles, aura, shadows on background, or frame borders. Sequence B for a three-cut human sword technique, frames5-8. Top-left: from high guard, right hand beside temple, elbow bent, stub angled up-right60 degrees; shoulders draw back for final cut; cape curls behind. Top-right: explosive torso-led horizontal finishing CUT, right fist at upper waist/chest level thrusting through a wide ARC rather than a fencing straight arm, stub points right, elbow slightly bent, left arm counterbalances, planted left lead foot, stern mature face fixed right. Bottom-left: followthrough with right hand low toward forward hip, stub angled25 degrees down-right, trailing foot pivots and settles, torso returns tall, cape falls in weighted folds. Bottom-right: fully composed tall recovery with low diagonal guard, stub145 degrees down-left, feet shoulder width, same source face and fitted armor. Compact readable martial swordsmanship, no oversized legs or deep crouch.
